notes: Community allocation (51%) are marked as TBD since there's no unlock schedule.
Airdrop (250M) is part of Year 1 community allocation, unlocked at TGE.
Staking rewards are tracked on-chain via RewardPaid events and subtracted from community incentives.

Community Incentives.methodology: 51% community allocation minus on-chain staking rewards already distributed.

community-incentives.name: Community Incentives
community-incentives.methodology: The remaining community allocation minus staking rewards tracked on-chain.

Staking Rewards.methodology: Tracks L3 rewards paid to stakers via the Layered Staking contract. Subtracted from community incentives allocation.

layered-staking.name: Layered Staking Rewards
layered-staking.methodology: Tracks RewardPaid events from the L3 staking contract on Ethereum.
